parameters.name: messages
parameters.value: =[{"role":"user","content":"Generate a coding task for a student bootcamp. The task should be: 1) Practical and hands-on 2) Suitable for intermediate level students 3) Include clear learning objectives 4) Have estimated duration of 60-120 minutes. Format as JSON with fields: title, description, difficulty_level, category, estimated_duration, learning_objectives (array)."}]

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, difficulty_level, category, estimated_duration, learning_objectives, generated_by_ai)
VALUES ('{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.description }}', '{{ $json.difficulty_level }}', '{{ $json.category }}', {{ $json.estimated_duration }}, '{{ $json.learning_objectives }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.generated_by_ai }}) RETURNING id
